body:
`next_id()` returns `len(notes) + 1`. After any `rm`, the count goes down, so the next `add` can get an ID that an existing note already has. Every command that takes an ID (`done`, `rm`) then acts on the first match, which may be the wrong note.

Suggested fix: `max(n["id"] for n in notes) + 1` (or 1 when empty).

Seen on jot 0.3.1, any OS.
title: IDs are reused after deleting a note
